questions.stem: What is meant by 'elastic recoil' in arteries?

options.text: The artery walls contract to prevent blood flowing backwards
The artery walls spring back between heartbeats, helping push blood forward
The artery walls permanently stretch wider over time
The artery walls absorb oxygen from the blood

questions.explanation: When the heart pumps blood into arteries, the elastic fibres in the artery walls stretch. Between heartbeats, they recoil (spring back) to their original size, pushing blood forward and smoothing the pulsating flow.
